title: Porsche Sales Executive
description:
An exceptional opportunity has arisen to join Porsche Centre Glasgow, representing one of the world's most iconic and aspirational automotive brands. Porsche is synonymous with performance, innovation, precision engineering, and an unrivalled heritage a marque recognised globally for setting the benchmark in luxury automotive excellence.

This rare opportunity is ideal for an ambitious, driven individual who thrives in a high-performance, client-focused environment. Based within our Glasgow Centre, the successful candidate will play a pivotal role in delivering an exceptional and seamless Porsche ownership experience, ensuring every client interaction reflects the brand's uncompromising standards and world-class reputation.

Alongside the opportunity to represent such an iconic brand, we are deeply committed to investing in our people through industry-leading training and development. From immersive manufacturer programmes to ongoing professional development, Porsche Centre Glasgow offers exceptional career progression and the opportunity to become a true brand expert within one of the automotive industry's most respected networks.

About the Role

This is far more than a traditional desk-based sales role. Porsche clients expect a premium, highly personalised experience built on trust, expertise, and accessibility. The successful candidate will therefore be highly visible, commercially engaged, and actively involved throughout every stage of the ownership journey.

You will be responsible for building long-term client relationships, achieving sales objectives, and delivering a bespoke and seamless Porsche experience that consistently reflects the brand's prestige and attention to detail. This role suits an individual who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where professionalism, emotional intelligence, and excellence are second nature.

Key Responsibilities
- Deliver exceptional sales performance and consistently exceed targets
- Build, develop, and maintain long-term client relationships
- Manage and advise on vehicle stock, specifications, and availability
- Ensure every client interaction is tailored, professional, and aligned with Porsche brand values
- Collaborate with colleagues to support overall Centre performance and business growth
- Maintain exceptional standards of presentation, process, and attention to detail
- Represent Porsche with integrity, passion, confidence, and expertise

About You

We are seeking an outstanding automotive sales professional with a proven track record within luxury, prestige, or high-performance vehicle sales. The successful candidate will be commercially astute, highly motivated, and passionate about delivering an exceptional customer experience worthy of the Porsche name.

You will demonstrate:
- A strong and consistent sales track record within prestige or luxury automotive brands
- Excellent commercial awareness and understanding of the premium automotive market
- Outstanding communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills
- Exceptional professionalism, presentation, and emotional intelligence
- A proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to thrive in a high-performance environment
- Genuine passion for Porsche, automotive excellence, and delivering world-class customer experiences

When applying for this role please consider that we require candidates to have automotive sales experience as a minimum requirement for this role.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.

- Career Development

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Sales Consultants - Glasgow

Up to 30,000 basic + uncapped commission & additional quarterly bonuses

Do you prefer working in a smaller sales team, allowing you to make a bigger impact? The beauty of our Glasgow office is that you'll be working for a global leading organisation, however you'll be situated in one of our smaller hubs, which means you'll be based in a close knit sales function, being able to make a bigger impact.

We still have all the typical stuff that any sales team enjoys - music pumping, incentives ran daily, leaderboards to win prizes, uncapped commission, and quarterly holidays and bonuses to hit.

So what do we do?

We are a consultancy service helping businesses with compliance, health & safety, audits, inspections, risk assessments, court cases, and many more.

Everything you do will be unscripted, we want your personality to shine through when selling services, giving you the chance to truly get to know your clients. The more meetings you book in, the more money you'll ultimately make.

Our top performing consultant is on track to earn 120,000 - that's game changing !

You get leads from all channels. You must be comfortable in picking up the phone and making dials happen whether that be a cold or warm call. We have leads coming from clients who have attended seminars, cancellations, website leads, and clients who have downloaded our brochures. You can even jump on the internet and self-source leads in your dedicated region, with most of our consultants given the freedom to pick an industry they like targeting the most.

Once 70% of your meetings are sat you'll be given premium leads, which is completely warm leads based. Hard work is genuinely rewarded with the good stuff. If you come across a client who is already with us, you can even upsell on additional products too.

What can I achieve?

The best route for most is moving into a Business Development Manager role, meaning you'll move into solely closing sales, getting you off the phones, going into a very senior position in the business, with the chance to earn up to 250 K per year.

We've even just announced a full companywide salary increase; we look after our staff.
- 24/7 access to our on-site state of the art gym
- Profit share scheme
- Basic salary reviews every 6 months
- 25 days holidays + BH + birthday off + rise every 2 & 5 years
- Early dart incentives sent out every single day
- 4 weeks of fully paid training
- Monthly wins incentive for you to earn an extra 1,500
- Deal makers book for you to earn points and pick prizes

So join our team, settle in, become a valued member of staff and start earning serious money!

X2 positions left available - November & January start dates available.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Start date: 25.01.2027

Shift Pattern: Full Time (37.5 hours)

Please note that this position is a full-time role only, and part-time hours are not available.

Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Glasgow team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Glasgow contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, discounted parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Sales Executive
description:
About Us:

Our global client is looking for dedicates sales executive their team. With a track record of excellence and a dedication to delivering superior solutions, we are expanding our team and looking for a dynamic B2 B Sales Executive to join us in achieving our ambitious goals.

Role Overview:

The B2 B Sales Executive will be a key player in our sales department, responsible for initiating contact with potential business clients through cold calling and outbound strategies. You will focus on setting appointments for our Business Development Managers (BDMs) and driving new business opportunities. Your role is critical in expanding our client base and contributing to our overall revenue targets.

Key Responsibilities:
- Cold Calling: Reach out to prospective clients via telephone and email to generate leads and establish initial contact.
- Lead Generation: Identify and target potential business opportunities, qualifying leads based on their potential value and fit with our offerings.
- Appointment Setting: Schedule meetings and product demonstrations for Business Development Managers with qualified leads.
- Sales Pipeline Management: Build and maintain a robust pipeline of prospects, ensuring regular follow-ups and updates in the CRM system.
- Collaboration: Work closely with BDMs and the sales team to align strategies, share insights, and refine sales approaches.
- Market Research: Stay informed about industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and enhance sales tactics.
- Reporting: Provide regular reports on lead generation activities, appointment setting, and sales performance to management.

What We're Looking For:
- Experience: Demonstrable experience in B2 B sales, particularly in cold calling and outbound lead generation. Experience in specific industry, if relevant is a plus.
- Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build rapport and influence decision-makers.
- Motivation: Self-motivated and target-driven, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
- Organizational Abilities: Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Team Player: Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

What We Offer:
- Competitive Salary: Base salary of 27,000 with an achievable OTE of 40,000.
- Incentives: Performance-based bonuses and incentives.
- Training: Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing training to enhance your skills and career development.
- Career Growth: Opportunities for advancement within a growing organization.
- Supportive Culture: A collaborative and inclusive work environment with a focus on professional growth and success.

How to Apply:

To apply for the B2 B Sales Executive position, please apply below or send your cv

We look forward to receiving your application and exploring how you can contribute to our team's success!
